title: Raspberries
content:
# Raspberries

Type: Food | Internal ID: Raspberry | Source: Raspberry bushes in, Meadows | Usage: Building, Crafting, Eating, Taming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 7 | Max Stamina: 20 | Duration: 10m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Raspberries are often found along the edges of large open meadows.
Raspberries are valuable in both early game as a basic food item and in mid-late game as a necessary ingredient for the early-tier Queen's jam and the Medium healing mead. Thus, gathering Raspberries when encountered is usually a good idea.

## Availability

• Bushes in the Meadows can be harvested for 1 Raspberries, affected by Farming (Skill). Bushes replenish after 5h. There is currently no way to replant berry bushes, and if they are destroyed they will not grow back.

### Building

• Blue, red and white banner
• Cartography table
• Purple banner
• White and red striped banner
• Yuleklapp (large)

### Crafting

• Mead base: Medium healing
• Mead base: Minor healing

• Mead base: Tasty

• Red firework
